I am Guo, a bovine and sheep veterinarian from China.
This channel shares real farm cases, practical diagnosis, and surgical procedures from my daily work.
All videos come from real clinical situations, aiming to help farmers and veterinarians worldwide learn useful and effective animal-health techniques.
